honors.title: Chancellor's Honors List
honors.description:
Students who in any quarter complete a minimum of 12 units for letter grades, with no grade below a "B" and no grade of "W", "NC" or "I," and who average 3.5 GPA or better for that quarter, will be placed on the Dean's Honor List.

If you are on the Dean's Honor List for all three quarters in an academic year, you will be placed on the Chancellor's Honors List.
honors.issuer: Issued by University of California, Riverside

projects.title: YerFont
projects.description:
Made a website that prompts a user to write specific characters, records the input as an .svg, and converts it into a .ttf file which can be uploaded onto a computer and used in place of everyday fonts.

Why it was built:
Making a personal font is a creative way to spend time but building it from the ground up is long and tedious, so we came up with the idea of making a website that is able to take a person's handwriting and convert it into a font right then and there. As opposed to regular fonts with a specific .svg associated with each letter, YerFont is able to blend multiple different entries of a specific person's handwriting to make it look as close as possible to natural handwriting. We also expended beyond just recording handwriting by using machine learning to create a completely new font that was not input by a human.
